message:
This is respond to Theresa Fry. I am not sure what state that you are in.

For Maryland, T-NETIX wanted Verizon customer to switch to them for direct billing and that they would credit them for the $1.95 that they were paying to have their calls presented on a Verizon bill.

They needed to do this by December 1st 2005. What the scoundrels failed to say is that they filed for an increase to go up to $2.49 in December and to be effective in January 2006.

They retrieve a portion of that amount, they also filed a tariff called a billing recovery fee.

If you live in Maryland you can go to MD PSC website and click under filings and type in company name and for year type 01/01/05 to 04/01/06.

The CSR's that answer the phones don't understand this stuff.
